sources.summary: Mistral AI released OCR 4 on June 23, 2026, moving from clean text extraction to structured document output. Each block returns a bounding box, a typed classification, and per-page and per-word confidence scores. The model supports 170 languages, runs in a single self-hosted container, and feeds citation-ready inputs into RAG, agentic, and enterprise search pipelines through one API endpoint. The post Mistral OCR 4 Brings Citation-Ready Structured Output to RAG, Agentic, and Enterprise Search Pipelines appeared first on MarkTechPost .
